statements.status_notes: Patching opentelemetry-api to version 1.62.0 breaks Elasticsearch 8.19.13 compatibility due to removal of io.opentelemetry.common.impl.ApiUsageLogger class. The component is tightly coupled to Elasticsearch's internal APM module. Waiting for upstream Elasticsearch update that bundles a compatible fixed version.
